# Haakim — Saddle Arabian delegate

[![Haakim between Celestia and Amira — Hasbro Studios/DHX Media, Magic Duel](https://derpicdn.net/img/view/2012/11/10/147544.jpg)](https://derpibooru.org/images/147544)

Haakim is the tall brown stallion who accompanies the pink, blue-maned Amira on diplomatic visits from Saddle Arabia. His horse-like proportions, golden mane and tail, violet eyes, and blue-and-gold ceremonial tack with a crescent and star distinguish him from ordinary Equestrian ponies. He has no visible cutie mark. His exact royal rank is not established.

- **Name:** Haakim is the established fandom/catalog name; the [character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Saddle_Arabia_delegates) reports merchandise usage, but the original naming source and alleged 2018 guide entry remain unverified. Gameloft officially labels him [Saddle Arabian Stallion](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Saddle_Arabian_Stallion), describing his devotion to his partner. Neither his personal name nor a marriage to Amira is established in television dialogue.
- **Voice:** No individual spoken dialogue or voice actor verified. The [Magic Duel transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Magic_Duel) records a shared exclamation of admiration by both delegates.
- **Other appearances:** In IDW's [Friendship is Magic #61: Convocation of the Creatures!](https://comicvine.gamespot.com/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic-61-convocation-/4000-643964/) (December 2017), the pair represent Saddle Arabia; this is a licensed comic appearance, separate from the television appearances below.

## Important moments

- **A diplomatic evening — [Magic Duel (S3E5)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=849wXnqtGMw):** He and Amira attend Twilight's magic show with Celestia and react with delight, marking the successful diplomatic visit after Trixie's defeat. Timestamp unavailable.
- **A seat among dignitaries — [Equestria Games (S4E24)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w5tPOH4MBu4):** The pair sit in the Crystal Empire's royal spectators' box, reinforcing their diplomatic standing. Timestamp unavailable.

These are his two documented television appearances; neither gives him an independent character arc.
